summary.text: Jerome Moon is a Republican state representative from Maryville representing Tennessee House District 8 (part of Blount County), a member of the 110th through 114th General Assemblies. He chairs the Cities & Counties Subcommittee.

paragraphs.text: Moon is a retired newspaper publisher who attended Maryville High School and the University of Tennessee.
He is married to Deborah; they have two daughters and four grandchildren.

He served on the Blount County Board of Commissioners from 2010 to 2017, chairing it from 2011 to 2017, and was commander of VFW Post 10855 in 2015-16; his page also lists an "All State Commander" title for the Veterans of Foreign Wars Department of Tennessee.
His page also lists past service as treasurer of the Tennessee Press Association and president of the United Way of Blount County.
